disambiguation: Not a base management tool; it is a visual styling layer for existing Bases views.
extras: Part of the Cool plugin suite; settings for the Cool Bar are shared across other Cool plugins.
problem: Users lack granular control over the visual presentation and layout of data displayed in Obsidian Bases.
summary: A visual design tool that allows users to customize the appearance, layout, and data mapping of cards displayed within Obsidian Bases.
